title: Reverse falsified predicate-lock coarsening: tighten max_pred_locks_per_page/relation
configuration_cause: max_pred_locks_per_page=2 and max_pred_locks_per_relation=-2 (defaults) were raised in r005/r006 to coarsen SIRead locking; r005 was refuted and r006 remains parked. The SERIALIZABLE retry regime is inactive (server_retry_ratio=0.0, rollback_ratio=0.0, lock_waiting_backends.max=0.0), so predicate-lock promotion is not the binding constraint; the falsified direction should be reversed to the tightest safe granularity to test whether finer SIRead locking reduces per-txn lock bookkeeping (locks_total.p95) without harming GetUserTweets tail.
mechanism: r005 raised max_pred_locks_per_page 2->8 and max_pred_locks_per_relation -2->4 and was refuted on TPS. r006 proposed a larger amplitude (32/16) but is untested. With zero server retries, zero rollbacks and zero lock waits, SIRead promotion is not causing serialization aborts; the coarsening direction is unsupported. Reversing to the safe low bounds (page=0, relation=0) forces the coarsest page/relation-level SIRead granularity, minimizing per-tuple predicate-lock bookkeeping and locks_total. This is a bounded direction reversal of a falsified group, not a replay.
query_effect: GetUserTweets (87.99% terminal capacity) predicate-lock bookkeeping per call should shrink; no plan change expected.
expected_tps_effect: Small increase (>=0.3%) if lock bookkeeping is on the critical path; unchanged if terminal saturation dominates.
expected_latency_effect: GetUserTweets p99 should not regress; locks_total.p95 should decrease.

predictions.rationale: Coarsest page/relation SIRead granularity reduces per-txn predicate-lock entries.
Less lock bookkeeping shortens the dominant transaction's tail.
Freed terminal capacity from GetUserTweets raises completed TPS.
No lock waits observed; granularity change should not create waits.

alternatives.statement: If GetUserTweets is purely terminal-bound, locks_total.p95 falls but TPS stays flat; then the bottleneck is client-side, not predicate locks.
If coarser SIRead granularity increases false conflicts, lock_waiting_backends.max rises above 0.

why_exceeds_incumbent: Reverses a falsified coarsening direction to the tightest safe granularity, testing whether finer SIRead locking reduces lock bookkeeping on the dominant transaction without touching the inactive retry regime.

knob_changes.numerical_basis: Safe low bound 0; reversal of falsified 2->8 (r005) and untested 2->32 (r006).
knob_changes.mechanism_role: page-level predicate-lock granularity cap; 0 forces coarsest page-level SIRead locking

knob_changes.numerical_basis: Safe low bound 0; reversal of falsified -2->4 (r005) and untested -2->16 (r006).
knob_changes.mechanism_role: relation-level predicate-lock granularity cap; 0 forces coarsest relation-level SIRead locking

nodes.label: Coarsest SIRead granularity minimizes per-txn predicate-lock bookkeeping
